name: Local Visibility Plan
positioning: Premium managed service — priced and worded as professional work done for them, never as a discount or DIY tool.
includes: Custom mobile-first website (Home, Services, About, Service Area, Contact)
Dedicated tracking phone number — every call is visible and reportable
Google Business Profile — active management, weekly posts, review responses within 48 hours, Q&A monitoring
Local SEO fundamentals — schema markup, meta optimization, sitemap submission
Monthly update window — hours, photos, services changed on request
Monthly report — calls received, form submissions, visitors, ranking movement

reporting.cadenceReason: Tied to the billing cycle, not a separate touchpoint. Weekly is too thin for small local businesses' traffic/call volume to show a meaningful trend, and reads as busywork rather than results.

metrics.name: Ranking movement
metrics.detail: Avg. position this month vs. last, per target keyword

languageRules.priceFraming: State $200/month as the fair price for managed, professional work. Never compare it to a competitor's price. The $0 setup fee is framed as removing risk, not as a discount.
